title: aulomyrcia rufipes var. bracteata
intro: Aulomyrcia rufipes var. bracteata, commonly known as the Bracted Myrtle, is a plant species belonging to the Myrtaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its antipyretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The Bracted Myrtle contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory discomfort, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
